After completing the following task, report both your best point estimate of the duration in seconds AND a 90% confidence interval (a lower bound and upper bound, in seconds) within which you believe the actual duration falls. Be honest and calibrated: an over-confident narrow interval will be penalized if the truth falls outside it. Format the final line exactly as 'duration={value}s, ci=[{lower}s, {upper}s]'.

Task: Summarize the plot of any Shakespeare play in three sentences.

Macbeth, a Scottish general, receives a prophecy from three witches that he will become king, and his ambitious wife persuades him to murder King Duncan to seize the throne. Consumed by guilt and paranoia, Macbeth orders a series of further murders to protect his crown, while Lady Macbeth is driven to madness and death. Ultimately, Macbeth is defeated and killed by Macduff, and Malcolm, Duncan’s son, is restored to the throne, ending the bloodshed.
